questions.title: Should the job start on every push?
commits: Blocks the merge until it passes

questions.title: Should a failed step retry?
commits: Retries each failed step three times

questions.title: Should the build cache its dependencies?
questions.recommendation: Yes, keyed on the lock file.
commits: Rebuilds the cache when the lock file changes

questions.title: How long may the build run?
commits: Fails a build that runs past ten minutes

questions.title: Which toolchain version does the build use?

alternatives.text: The version the lock file names
